confirmActivate.description: Only one academic year can be active at a time. This will become the default year across the app until it's completed.

confirmComplete.description: Completed academic years can no longer be edited directly — use "Correct schedule" afterward if a date needs fixing.

confirmArchive.description: It will no longer count toward school-closed days, but stays in the calendar's history.

copyDialog.title: Copy events from another year
copyDialog.description: Copies every active event from the year you choose into the currently selected year, using the exact same dates. Review the copied entries afterward — dates tied to the Islamic calendar (Eid, Ramadan-linked closures) shift earlier every year and won't be correct as-is.
